summary:
Echoes of Space is an interactive educational website designed to help users discover the history of space exploration and learn about forgotten space equipment and scientific instruments left behind on the Moon and Mars.
The main objective of this project is to create awareness about past space missions by presenting information about abandoned machines, spacecraft, rovers, and scientific instruments in an interesting and user-friendly way.
details:
The project aims to create a virtual space museum where users can explore the Moon and Mars, discover forgotten space artifacts, and understand the historical importance of space exploration.The exact implementation technologies should be confirmed from your project source code. A typical implementation for this type of website may use:

  • HTML – Website structure.
  • CSS – Design and styling.
  • JavaScript – Interactive functionality.
  • Netlify – Website hosting and deployment
